title: The deploy keys stay repository secrets
quote: Keep DEPLOY_SSH_KEY and DEPLOY_KNOWN_HOSTS where they are.
means: The deploy's two secrets stay repository secrets instead of moving into the environment production. The risk is accepted and written into aip-59ad's assumptions: a workflow on any branch could read them.

reflection.checked: every decision before d-ca32 that held
reflection.result: supersedes nothing; the move into the environment was only proposed in aip-59ad's revision 2
